neighbours.label: ' the' where the next word is predicted to be a large collective or global noun (the Environment, the world, the public, the Universe, the Interior), often inside an institution or title name, as against ' the' before an ordinary concrete noun
fire: The Ministry of the Environment issued new rules on factory emissions.
Small changes at home can help protect the environment for future generations.
The documentary follows two sailors trying to travel around the world in a year.
After the renovation, the gardens will be open to the public every weekend.
Her book offers a simple guide to the universe for curious teenagers.
He served as Secretary of the Interior under two presidents.
Volunteers from across the country came to clean up the coastline.
The new policy is meant to benefit the community as a whole.
quiet: The Ministry staff issued new badges to every factory worker.
Small changes at home can help fix the sink before it leaks again.
The documentary follows two sailors trying to repair the boat in a week.
After the renovation, the gardens will have a fountain near the gate.
Her book offers a simple guide to the kitchen for nervous beginners.
He served as captain of the ship for two seasons.
Volunteers from the school came to paint the fence on Saturday.
The new policy is meant to shorten the queue at the counter.
